about: Source features that the evidence shows are wrong. 'exclude': they stay in the master dataset (flagged, confidence low) but are kept out of the game map; a feature is only excluded when independent evidence contradicts it. 'heights': storey counts and heights that reference photos contradict (the footprint is not touched). 'reclass': ground areas whose mapped use the reference photos and the owner contradict (the outline is kept). 'reshape': an outline that sits off the building Google Open Buildings and the owner's imagery show is replaced by a measured ring (game metres); the OSM id and tags stay. 'addAreas': ground areas the owner's imagery shows and the sources lack (woods round the School of Law and International House), measured on the registered imagery. 'addWays': ways the owner's photos show and the sources lack (Commonwealth's stairway from the gate houses to the forecourt, Volta's forecourt); their ends are inserted into the way they meet so the network stays connected, except an end marked 'open' (at the foot of a flight of steps up to a door).

reshape.reason: The owner's aerial of Volta Hall, registered to the hall's OSM footprints (which land on their roofs), shows the Annex's roof 12.4 m west of its OSM outline; the outline's shape (a C open to the west round a second, closed court) matches the roof, so it is moved, not redrawn.

addWays.name: Commonwealth Hall stairs
addWays.reason: Owner's photos: from the two gate houses on the road at the end of the avenue, a long stairway climbs Legon Hill to the drive in front of Commonwealth Hall's main entrance; near the top it passes either side of a stone structure with three arches.

addWays.name: Volta Hall forecourt
addWays.reason: Owner's aerial and photos: a paved forecourt between the two front buildings runs from Volta Hall Road to the foot of the short flight of steps (between stone walls) up to the arched entrance; rides stop at the foot of the steps.

addWays.name: Legon Hall Annex walk
addWays.reason: Owner's top view of the Legon Hall annexes: a paved walk runs west across the lawns from Agyei Bart Crescent (leaving it at its bend) to Annex C's gate (marked) on the east face of its long block.

addWays.name: Legon Hall Annex B walk
addWays.reason: Owner's top view: a paved walk runs south from the cross walk to Annex B's entrance (marked) at the east end of its north face.
